reasoning: The patch removes security checks but doesn't introduce malicious code. Deepseek's comprehensive analysis correctly distinguishes between reduced robustness and actual malicious behavior. Qwen's 'unsafe' verdict overreacts to legitimate packaging adjustments.
disagreement_analysis: Different interpretation of sanitize.patch: Qwen flagged removed security checks as malicious, while Deepseek correctly noted no malicious code was added.
coverage_issues: Qwen failed to review wrapper scripts (ventoy, ventoyweb, etc.) that execute installed binaries
false_positives: Qwen's verdict on sanitize.patch: Removal of root checks/log changes is packaging optimization, not malicious code execution
learnings: Prioritize review of files referenced in PKGBUILD functions (prepare/package) over upstream source code
Clarify prompt: Distinguish between security-reducing packaging choices vs actual malicious code
Improve patch analysis: Focus on net additions rather than removals unless deletions enable exploitation
